title: Your Investments Just Got Simpler: New Nomination Rules for Demat Accounts & Mutual Funds

faq.q: What happens if I don't nominate and don't opt out for a new single account after September 1, 2026?
faq.a: If you open a new single-holder Demat account or mutual fund folio after September 1, 2026, you will be required to either provide nomination details or submit an explicit opt-out declaration. You cannot proceed without choosing one of these options.

Yes, you can nominate a minor. In such a case, you will also need to provide the minor nominee's date of birth and details of a guardian who will manage the investments until the minor becomes an adult.

faq.q: How many nominees can I add?
faq.a: You can add up to three nominees for your Demat account or mutual fund folio.

faq.q: Do I need to provide the percentage share for each nominee?
faq.a: It's advisable to specify the percentage share for each nominee. If you don't, the investments will be divided equally among all named nominees by default.

faq.q: Where can I find the official SEBI circular?
faq.a: The official SEBI circular (SEBI/HO/OIAE/OIAE_IAD-3/P/CIR/2026/12676) dated May 29, 2026, is usually available on the SEBI website under the "Circulars" section.
